script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id, j.organization_id, j.command, j.job_status, j.lease_owner, (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live, j.row_version, j.attempt_count,
       j.idempotency_key, j.correlation_id, j.request_payload, j.is_deleted
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_PPguard.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', h.`id`, 'to_status', h.`to_status`, 'plant_id', h.`plant_id`, 'to_id', h.`to_id`, 'movement_type', h.`movement_type`, 'ref_doc_type', h.`ref_doc_type`,
		'gr_no', h.`gr_no`, 'receiving_no', h.`receiving_no`, 'supplier_id', h.`supplier_id`, 'assigned_to', h.`assigned_to`, 'created_by', h.`created_by`, 'created_at',
		DATE_FORMAT(h.`created_at`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), 'organization_id', h.`organization_id`, 'ref_doc', h.`ref_doc`, 'remarks', h.`remarks`, 'create_user', h.`create_user`,
		'create_dept', h.`create_dept`, 'create_time', SUBSTRING(DATE_FORMAT(h.`create_time`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), 1, 23), 'update_user', h.`update_user`, 'update_time',
		SUBSTRING(DATE_FORMAT(h.`update_time`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), 1, 23), 'is_deleted', h.`is_deleted`, 'tenant_id', h.`tenant_id`, 'quality_insp_no', h.`quality_insp_no`,
		'qi_id', h.`qi_id`, 'sub_tenant_id', h.`sub_tenant_id`, 'to_id_sn', h.`to_id_sn`, 'to_id_type', h.`to_id_type`, 'previous_status', h.`previous_status`, 'is_processing',
		h.`is_processing`, 'project_id', h.`project_id`) AS j
  FROM transfer_order_putaway h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_PPentry.data.toId}} AND h.is_deleted = 0

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', l.`id`, 'line_index', l.`line_index`, 'item_code', l.`item_code`, 'item_name', l.`item_name`, 'item_desc', l.`item_desc`, 'batch_no', l.`batch_no`,
		'source_inv_category', l.`source_inv_category`, 'received_qty', l.`received_qty`, 'item_uom', l.`item_uom`, 'source_bin', l.`source_bin`, 'qty_to_putaway', l.`qty_to_putaway`,
		'pending_process_qty', l.`pending_process_qty`, 'putaway_qty', l.`putaway_qty`, 'target_location', l.`target_location`, 'remark', l.`remark`, 'button_split_d_mchzv',
		l.`button_split_d_mchzv`, 'line_status', l.`line_status`, 'is_split', l.`is_split`, 'parent_or_child', l.`parent_or_child`, 'parent_index', l.`parent_index`, 'unit_price',
		l.`unit_price`, 'total_price', l.`total_price`, 'po_no', l.`po_no`, 'qi_no', l.`qi_no`, 'target_inv_category', l.`target_inv_category`, 'serial_numbers', l.`serial_numbers`,
		'is_serialized_item', l.`is_serialized_item`, 'select_serial_number', l.`select_serial_number`, 'select_serial_numbers_d_prsys', l.`select_serial_numbers_d_prsys`,
		'storage_location', l.`storage_location`, 'hu_data', l.`hu_data`, 'gr_line_id', l.`gr_line_id`, 'handling_unit_id', l.`handling_unit_id`, 'project_id', l.`project_id`,
		'parent_id', l.`parent_id`, 'item_bundle_id', l.`item_bundle_id`) AS j
  FROM transfer_order_putaway_jz8m9w3h_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.transfer_order_putaway_id = {{node:code_node_PPentry.data.toId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY l.id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', r.`id`, 'item_code', r.`item_code`, 'item_name', r.`item_name`, 'item_desc', r.`item_desc`, 'batch_no', r.`batch_no`, 'source_inv_category',
		r.`source_inv_category`, 'store_in_qty', r.`store_in_qty`, 'item_uom', r.`item_uom`, 'target_location', r.`target_location`, 'remark', r.`remark`, 'confirmed_by',
		r.`confirmed_by`, 'confirmed_at', DATE_FORMAT(r.`confirmed_at`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), 'line_index', r.`line_index`, 'target_inv_category', r.`target_inv_category`,
		'serial_numbers', r.`serial_numbers`, 'parent_id', r.`parent_id`, 'job_line_key', r.`job_line_key`) AS j
  FROM transfer_order_putaway_vrqs3cmr_sub r
 WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND r.transfer_order_putaway_id = {{node:code_node_PPentry.data.toId}} AND r.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY r.id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(g.`id` AS CHAR), 'gr_no', g.`gr_no`, 'gr_status', g.`gr_status`, 'putaway_status', g.`putaway_status`, 'organization_id', g.`organization_id`,
		'plant_id', CAST(g.`plant_id` AS CHAR), 'update_time', SUBSTRING(DATE_FORMAT(g.`update_time`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), 1, 23)) AS j
  FROM goods_receiving g
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND g.id = {{node:code_node_PPentry.data.grId}} AND g.is_deleted = 0

SELECT JSON_MERGE_PRESERVE(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(i.`id` AS CHAR), 'based_uom', CAST(i.`based_uom` AS CHAR), 'item_batch_management', i.`item_batch_management`, 'material_costing_method',
		i.`material_costing_method`, 'serial_number_management', i.`serial_number_management`, 'stock_control', i.`stock_control`, 'material_code', i.`material_code`),
		JSON_OBJECT('table_uom_conversion', COALESCE(
         (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('alt_uom_id', CAST(u.`alt_uom_id` AS CHAR), 'base_qty', u.`base_qty`)) OVER (ORDER BY u.id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
            FROM item_mji552rc_sub u WHERE u.Item_id = i.id AND u.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1), JSON_ARRAY()))) AS j
  FROM item i
 WHERE i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND i.is_deleted = 0
   AND i.id IN (SELECT l.item_code FROM transfer_order_putaway_jz8m9w3h_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.transfer_order_putaway_id = {{node:code_node_PPentry.data.toId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.item_code IS NOT NULL)
 ORDER BY i.id

SELECT u.j FROM (
SELECT t.id AS k, JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(t.`id` AS CHAR), 'doc_type', t.`doc_type`, 'doc_id', t.`doc_id`, 'doc_no', t.`doc_no`, 'doc_line_id', t.`doc_line_id`, 'line_no',
		t.`line_no`, 'parent_id', t.`parent_id`, 'parent_no', t.`parent_no`, 'parent_line_id', t.`parent_line_id`, 'material_id', CAST(t.`material_id` AS CHAR), 'item_code',
		t.`item_code`, 'item_name', t.`item_name`, 'item_desc', t.`item_desc`, 'item_uom', CAST(t.`item_uom` AS CHAR), 'batch_id', CAST(t.`batch_id` AS CHAR), 'handling_unit_id',
		t.`handling_unit_id`, 'plant_id', CAST(t.`plant_id` AS CHAR), 'organization_id', t.`organization_id`, 'transit_bin', CAST(t.`transit_bin` AS CHAR), 'from_plant_id',
		CAST(t.`from_plant_id` AS CHAR), 'from_bin', CAST(t.`from_bin` AS CHAR), 'from_category', t.`from_category`, 'to_plant_id', CAST(t.`to_plant_id` AS CHAR), 'to_bin',
		CAST(t.`to_bin` AS CHAR), 'to_category', t.`to_category`, 'transit_qty', t.`transit_qty`, 'received_qty', t.`received_qty`, 'open_qty', t.`open_qty`, 'status',
		t.`status`, 'transit_date', DATE_FORMAT(t.`transit_date`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), 'received_date', DATE_FORMAT(t.`received_date`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), 'remark',
		t.`remark`, 'target_doc_type', t.`target_doc_type`, 'target_doc_id', t.`target_doc_id`, 'target_doc_no', t.`target_doc_no`, 'target_doc_line_id', t.`target_doc_line_id`,
		'source_transit_id', t.`source_transit_id`) AS j
  FROM in_transit_detail t
 WHERE t.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND t.doc_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.grId}}' AND t.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.organizationId}}' AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'In Transit'
UNION ALL
SELECT t.id AS k, JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(t.`id` AS CHAR), 'status', t.`status`, 'material_id', CAST(t.`material_id` AS CHAR), 'batch_id', CAST(t.`batch_id` AS CHAR),
		'transit_bin', CAST(t.`transit_bin` AS CHAR)) AS j
  FROM in_transit_detail t
 WHERE t.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND t.doc_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.grId}}' AND t.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.organizationId}}' AND t.is_deleted = 0
   AND (t.status IS NULL OR t.status <> 'In Transit')
) u
 ORDER BY u.k

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(p.id AS CHAR), 'to_status', p.to_status) AS j
  FROM transfer_order_putaway p
 WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND p.gr_no = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.grId}}' AND p.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY p.id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(b.id AS CHAR), 'receiving_insp_status', b.receiving_insp_status) AS j
  FROM basic_inspection_lot b
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND b.goods_receiving_no = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.grId}}' AND b.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY b.id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(s.`id` AS CHAR), 'plant_id', CAST(s.`plant_id` AS CHAR), 'organization_id', s.`organization_id`, 'movement_type', s.`movement_type`,
		'putaway_required', s.`putaway_required`, 'auto_trigger_to', s.`auto_trigger_to`, 'auto_completed_gr', s.`auto_completed_gr`, 'putaway_mode', s.`putaway_mode`,
		'default_loading_bay', CAST(s.`default_loading_bay` AS CHAR), 'is_loading_bay', s.`is_loading_bay`, 'storage_location_id', CAST(s.`storage_location_id` AS CHAR),
		'category', s.`category`, 'show_hu', s.`show_hu`) AS j
  FROM putaway_setup s
 WHERE s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.plant_id = (SELECT h.plant_id FROM transfer_order_putaway h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_PPentry.data.toId}} AND h.is_deleted = 0) AND s.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.organizationId}}'
 ORDER BY s.id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(b.`id` AS CHAR), 'material_id', CAST(b.`material_id` AS CHAR), 'location_id', CAST(b.`location_id` AS CHAR), 'batch_id', CAST(b.`batch_id` AS CHAR),
		'plant_id', CAST(b.`plant_id` AS CHAR), 'organization_id', b.`organization_id`, 'manufacturing_date', DATE_FORMAT(b.`manufacturing_date`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),
		'expired_date', DATE_FORMAT(b.`expired_date`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) AS j
  FROM item_batch_balance b
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.organizationId}}' AND b.plant_id = (SELECT h.plant_id FROM transfer_order_putaway h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_PPentry.data.toId}} AND h.is_deleted = 0)
   AND (b.material_id, b.location_id, b.batch_id) IN (SELECT l.item_code, l.source_bin, l.batch_no FROM transfer_order_putaway_jz8m9w3h_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.transfer_order_putaway_id = {{node:code_node_PPentry.data.toId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0
        AND l.batch_no IS NOT NULL AND l.source_bin IS NOT NULL)
 ORDER BY b.id

SELECT p.step_name, p.result_ref
  FROM gd_publish_step p
 WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = CONCAT('PWC|', '{{node:code_node_PPentry.data.toId}}') AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY p.id DESC
 LIMIT 1
